describes: A coping slab of split slate across the top of a dry wall (port step 2b, R2a; the design's SN2, SN4 and SN9): a rigid block on its bed, its top and bed the laminae's planes, its long sides and ends split, one plane each; as wide as the wall's top and its overhangs, its front a seeded few mm proud of the stair's face. An open end (where its run ends over a riser) is drawn whole and may be knocked at its top corners; a joint end is set in by its half joint and drawn where the joint is seen. L0 chamfers the top's arrises, its perimeter, and only those: the bed's would face down (SN7), each end's upright arrises would make corners where three chamfers meet in a point too fine to draw (SN8), and a knock is a break after the dressing, its arrises sharp.

chamferMm.note: SN4: the top's arrises chamfered, a seeded leg of 10 to 12 mm per slab.

chamferMeasure.note: Measured along each face, as a mason gives it (C10); 'face' (the chamfer's width) is not built.

arrisMaxDeg.note: Two faces meeting at a turn of 20 degrees or more meet at an arris (a face's own facets never do: they are one face).

bedChamfer.note: As the wall stone's: the bed's arrises square (SN7).

uprightChamfer.note: The ends' upright arrises square: each meets two of the top's at a corner, and three chamfers meet in a point whose tips are under SN8's 2 px at 8 m whatever the triangulation; two meet in a mitre (blender.md, the corners).

chipChamfer.note: A knock is a break after the dressing: sharp, through the top's chamfers.

chipPerMille.note: An open end's top corners knocked, per mille of corners (SN4: chips at a coping's ends).

chipLegMm.note: A knock's legs along and back, least and most: at least SN9's 50 mm (no sliver).

patches.note: The face patches (blender/parts/stone/slate/patches.manifest.json; SN6) each kind of face draws one from by seed: a split face from the split ones, the top and bed (bed faces) from the bed ones.

chipDepthPerMille.note: And down at most this share of the slab's thickness, per mille: a knock takes no more than half the coping.

note: Sizes from R1's walling table (packs/stavanger-1989/walling.json, the dry-split-1874 working) and its laying: w a coping's cell (copeLeastMm 200 where a run leaves less than a slab, to copeLengthMm's 1000) less a half joint (2 to 6 mm) at each joint end; h its run's thickness (copeThickMm 70 to 100) less its bed's half joint; d the wall's top (wall.py's 420 mm) and its overhangs (50 mm on a standing wall). Levels: the design's SN8 budgets per piece (120 and 48); their errors are the wall kind's (kinds/wall.json: levels), the one source (design.md SN8): L1's is L0's chamfers' (8.5 mm at a 12 mm leg; up to 9.8 mm at a corner where two meet). L2 to L4 are the chunk's. The part's own numbers are its params, each with its reason; the working's (joints, batter, the top's thickness, the overhang and how proud the front stands) are walling.json's (reviews/lt1/port/2b/r2a/stones/blender.md, Data and code).
